PZZ700-232200-
216 AM PDT Fri Oct 23 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 AM, a 1028 mb high was 400 nautical miles west of Cape
Mendocino and a 1011 mb low covered the northern Gulf of
California. A brisk southeast coastal breeze is expected this 
morning. Isolated northwest wind gusts will exceed 20 knots today
in the outer waters. Weak offshore flow near shore during the 
nights and mornings will alternate with onshore northwest flow 
during the afternoons and evenings for tonight through Tuesday.

$$
